video_caption: The video segment opens with the text "PSYCHOSEXUAL" appearing centrally on a white background with abstract white cloud-like shapes surrounding a bright orange circle, which then changes to "PSYCHOSEXUAL DEVELOPMENT" as a small, cartoon-style baby in a white suit appears seated in the lower-left, looking up at five white, rectangular pillars numbered 1 through 5, emerging from the bottom towards the orange circle. The scene transitions to a white background with a black-outlined mountain labelled "LIBIDO" at its base, from which white cloud-like puffs and an upward-pointing arrow emanate. Subsequently, five thought-bubble-like clouds appear around the mountain, each containing a number and a scene: cloud 1 (bottom left) shows a woman bottle-feeding a baby; cloud 2 (top left) depicts a child in a diaper on a potty; cloud 3 (middle right) features a man, woman, and small girl, with the man holding the girl; cloud 4 (top right) illustrates a woman in bed holding a flower; and cloud 5 (bottom right) shows a young man and woman facing each other. The scene then shifts to a man with dark hair and a white shirt holding a pointer stick on the left, looking surprised, alongside a younger boy with light hair and a white shirt, who looks shocked with his hands to his face. As the speaker mentions "fixations", a sequence of images appears: the younger boy is depicted with three thought bubbles chained around him, making him look distressed; above him, another man is chained by the neck to a bottle; and to the right, a figure sits huddled in a corner, looking sad, with a large, dense cloud of money or crumpled items above their head.

The video segment, titled "ORAL PHASE (AGE 0 - 1)," begins by showing a black and white line drawing of a baby with a pacifier in its mouth, lying on its back. This visual represents the first year of life where discovery happens through oral senses. Two more drawings of mothers and babies then appear: one woman with curly hair in an orange shirt breastfeeding a baby, and another woman with straight hair in a white shirt bottle-feeding a baby. This illustrates different ways infants receive oral satisfaction. Next, a drawing of a baby named Hans appears, sitting on a blanket, playing with a toy and a baby bottle, representing successful weaning without trauma. Following this, a woman with straight hair, wearing a white shirt and gray pants, stands with her hands clasped, looking down at a baby (Ernst) who is looking up at her with an open mouth, symbolizing early weaning. Another crying baby, Eda, is then shown lying on its back, left alone and hungry, depicting a lack of oral stimulation. The scene then transitions to adulthood, showing a smiling, healthy, and independent adult man (Hans) with a jacket over his shoulder. To his right, another adult man (Ernst) is shown, chewing gum and blowing a bubble, representing an oral fixation. Finally, an adult woman (Eda) appears on the far right with an angry expression, and behind her, another man sits in a chair, disheveled, holding a bottle and cigarette, representing addictive and manipulative personalities due to early oral deprivation. Ernst's gum bubble turns orange, indicating the fulfillment of his oral fixation.

The video opens with the text "ANAL PHASE (AGE 1-3)" at the top left, introducing Freud's second stage of psychosexual development. In the first panel, a young boy named Hans, with curly hair, sits on a potty in a tiled bathroom, looking up at his smiling, encouraging parents who stand in a doorway clapping. In the middle panel, another young boy, Ernst, pushes away a potty held by a stern-looking woman, his mother, indicating forced potty training. His hands are outstretched in protest. In the right panel, a young girl named Eda stands with her head down, looking sad, and a puddle on the floor suggests a potty training accident, implying parental neglect. The scene transitions to three adult panels. The left panel shows an adult Hans, now with a confident smile, shaking hands with an older, smiling man in a suit, representing a good relationship with authority. Part of Hans's shirt and hand are colored orange. The middle panel depicts an adult Ernst, looking worried and reserved, crossing his arms and standing apart from a small group of somber people behind him. His hands are colored orange, signifying an anal retentive personality. The right panel shows an adult Eda, looking distraught and rebellious, with her hands colored orange, while a furious man in a suit yells and points at her, illustrating an anal expulsive personality and rebellion against authority.

The video begins with the text "PHALLIC PHASE (AGE 3 - 6)" at the top of a white screen, followed by a cartoon drawing of a boy's head appearing on the left, then a girl's head next to him. Their full, naked bodies are drawn, standing in a corner, with glowing lines around their heads and groin areas. The lines around their genitals become colored (yellow for the boy, green/yellow for the girl). A new scene appears in the top right, showing a smiling adult woman holding and hugging a young boy, both with curly hair. An adult man with curly hair then appears, smiling and putting his arm around the woman, representing the boy's father. Below this, a smaller boy (Hans) is shown happily pushing a wheeled toy, followed by a stylized image of a screaming man falling into a dark pit, illustrating Hans's desire to "get rid of his father." A large, dark, menacing shadow of a man then appears over a small, scared boy, depicting "castration anxiety." Subsequently, a girl points angrily at a boy who appears frightened and covers his chest, representing "penis envy," while a picture of a woman's face in a heart frame and several trophies appear on a shelf behind them, symbolizing power and dominance. The screen then splits horizontally into two framed sections. In the top frame, the adult man from before stands with an arm around an older man, and an older woman stands beside them, all smiling. The adult man's collar turns yellow, and the older man's collar turns orange. In the bottom frame, a young man with wavy hair is shown looking at a picture of a woman's face within a heart frame, suggesting a mother fixation. This scene is then replaced by an image of a man angrily pointing at a woman on a couch, with trophies and the woman's face in a heart frame visible in the background, signifying competition. Finally, the video shows a sad woman with crossed arms in orange pants, being pointed at by a smiling man in gray pants, illustrating the concept of "penis envy" leading to an "inferiority complex" for women.

The video opens with the text "LATENT PHASE (AGE 7 - 13)" displayed in the top left corner, introducing the subject of the segment. On a plain white background, a line drawing of a young boy with short hair and a backpack appears on the left, looking to the right with a smile. As the video progresses, a second boy, similarly styled with a backpack, is drawn next to the first, also smiling and appearing to be in conversation. Following them, a girl with long, wavy hair is drawn, facing the boys and raising her index finger as if making a statement. To the right of this group, a rectangular frame materializes, inside which a girl with long hair is depicted wearing a crop top and holding a microphone, singing with an exaggerated open mouth and "BOOM!"-like lines indicating loud sound or energy. The narration explains, "In this phase, our libido is suppressed as our sexual energy is being sublimated into developing life skills."

The video opens with the text "GENITAL PHASE (PUBERTY - DEATH)" displayed in the upper left corner. A line drawing of a smiling man with curly hair appears, then his full body is drawn as he reclines on a couch. A woman with long hair then appears next to him, leaning her head on his shoulder. A second man, with a mustache, then sits on the other side of the woman, looking at her. A thought bubble appears above the mustached man, initially showing a woman's face, which then transforms into an image of a couple kissing passionately. Subsequently, a thought bubble appears above the woman's head, revealing an angry-looking woman with raised hands. The scene then transitions, showing a sequence of three figures illustrating growth: a baby crawling, a young boy, and a slightly older boy. An orange arrow curves from the older boy towards a smiling adult man with curly hair, who is depicted first smiling, then engaged in work at a computer, and finally in a loving relationship with a woman, indicated by a heart-shaped thought bubble. To the right, a frowning man in a jacket is shown being admonished by a police officer. Below this, a figure wearing a pig snout and glasses appears. Further to the right, a couple is shown kissing, followed by a smiling woman, who then transforms into a woman depicted in the act of slapping someone.

The video opens with a white background. On the left, a cartoon drawing of a man with short hair and a thoughtful expression is shown with his hand on his chin and the other on his hip, while three orange question marks float above his head. Above him, a circular thought bubble contains a drawing of an older man with a beard, wearing a suit, and pointing his finger to the right. Below these, a cartoon head is depicted with the top of its skull open, revealing a brain inside. From 0:06 to 0:08, a small speech bubble appears above the open brain, containing a tiny smiling face. This is then replaced from 0:08 to 0:10 by a different speech bubble containing a drawing of a happy baby in a yellow/orange onesie, waving its arms and legs. Subsequently, from 0:10 to 0:13, another speech bubble emerges, showing an angry young boy with his hands on his hips. The text "Produced on MinuteVideos.com" is visible in the bottom right corner of the screen.

The video segment illustrates Freud's structural model of the psyche, initially using a submarine analogy and then a comic strip. From 00:06 to 00:19, a black-and-white submarine is shown partially submerged in water with small fish swimming around it. Text labels appear sequentially: "UNCONSCIOUS" (0:07) points to a bed with two pillows (representing the Id) inside a speech bubble below the submarine, then "PRECONSCIOUS" (0:10) appears, pointing to a praying angel with a halo (representing the Superego) inside a speech bubble above the water line, and finally "CONSCIOUS" (0:15) appears, pointing to a weighing scale (representing the Ego) inside a speech bubble above the submarine, all demonstrating the different levels and their corresponding psychoanalytic components. From 00:20 to 00:41, the scene shifts to a three-panel comic strip. The left panel, labeled "ID", shows a woman from the chest down and a young boy. The boy points enthusiastically at an ice cream cone on a poster, which then turns orange. The right panel, labeled "SUPEREGO", shows a man seen from behind, and a young boy bowing with his hands clasped together, depicting moral regulation. The middle panel, labeled "EGO", shows a man clenching his jaw and pulling on two vertical bars, symbolizing the Ego's struggle to balance the demands of the Id and Superego.

In a black and white hand-drawn animation, a man resembling Sigmund Freud, with glasses, a mustache, and a beard, is depicted sitting thoughtfully in an armchair on the left side of the frame. He wears a dark suit and tie, with his right hand resting on his chin and his legs crossed. The background is a stark white. At 0:06, a thought bubble emerges from his head, and inside it, a cartoon-like brain character with short legs and a blindfold begins to materialize.

The video segment features a static, black-and-white cartoon illustration of a psychotherapy session against a white background. On the left, an older man with a mustache and glasses, wearing a suit, sits thoughtfully in an armchair with his hand on his chin, representing a therapist. Above him, a thought bubble contains a small, orange, furry, brain-like creature with a zippered head, wearing a blindfold and appearing somewhat confined, symbolizing the patient's "neuroses." On the right, a younger man with spiky hair, wearing a shirt and pants, lies on a psychotherapy couch, looking upwards with an open mouth as if speaking. Above him, a large thought bubble illustrates his internal thoughts: initially an empty cloud, it then transforms to show a smiling, orange brain-like creature with arms and legs, holding a small box or key, which then appears next to a translucent, angry or surprised ghost-like figure with spiky hair emerging from a smoky trail, representing his "complexes" and issues being revealed or confronted. In the bottom right corner, the text "Produced on MinutoVideos.com" (meaning the video was created by MinutoVideos.com) is visible.

The video opens with a cartoon man with short, spiky grey hair, wearing a grey long-sleeved shirt and dark pants, smiling and gesturing with both hands as if presenting something. Above his head is a speech bubble containing a golden question mark. To his right, an orange, brain-like creature with limbs sits in a white armchair, looking intently at a screen. A projector on a small table behind the brain-like creature casts an image of a young boy building sandcastles on a beach onto the white wall. Another cartoon man with short dark hair, wearing a white shirt, appears at the bottom right, smiling and looking at the projected image. The text "Produced on MinuteVideos.com" is visible in the bottom right corner. This scene fades into animated text appearing: "learning by failing" (the word "failing" highlighted in red) which then changes to "learning by doing" (the word "doing" highlighted in orange). This transitions to a logo: "sprouts SCHOOLS" in purple text, surrounded by scattered, colorful geometric shapes (circles, squares, triangles, stars). Next, a "THANK YOU" screen displays a list of names: "A SPECIAL THANK YOU TO: AVIGAIL BADRAH CEDRIC WANG DENIS KRAUS ESTHER CHIANG EVA MARIE KOBLIN GINGER TSUNGREN YANG And All The Other Patrons! Join us". The scene then shows a white, rectangular screen with a "creative commons" logo at the top left. A woman with red hair, glasses, a red shirt, and grey pants stands to the left of the screen, holding a book, while a group of diverse children sit on the floor watching. A projector is placed on a stool and projects an image of a video player with a "play" button onto the screen. As the scene expands, the screen becomes part of a building, revealing people working in offices inside and a city skyline in the background, transitioning from day to night. The projector continues to cast the "creative commons" video onto the building's exterior. This changes to a cartoon man with short brown hair, wearing a purple long-sleeved shirt, standing with a thumbs-up gesture and holding a rolled-up dollar bill in his other hand, looking excited. A pink piggy bank appears below his hand. A red rectangular box with the text "patreon.com/sprouts" appears above him. Another smiling cartoon man with dark hair then appears, dropping a green dollar bill into the piggy bank. This fades to a man with short brown hair, wearing a red long-sleeved shirt, with a thoughtful expression and his hand on his chin. A thought bubble next to him contains a graduation cap, a diploma, and a stack of books. A large red arrow points downwards, leading to a yellow text box displaying "WWW.SPROUTSSCHOOLS.COM". Finally, the video concludes with credits text on a white background: "SCRIPT: SELINA BADOR DRAWINGS: PASCAL GAGGELLI VOICE: MATT ABBOTT RECORDING: NALIN EDITING: PEERA LERTSUKITTIPONGSA CREATIVE DIRECTOR: JONAS KOBLIN Made With MinuteVideos.com".
